text:
sam: Heads-up — we're proposing to deprecate implicit default model selection and require an Accept-Model header on API requests. Proposal: 8-week grace period, SDKs auto-add the current default during the window. Thoughts?

maria: +1 on the timeline. Can we ensure a server fallback to a safe default for older clients during the grace period?

kevin: Agree but need clarity on telemetry. How will we surface unauthenticated/unpinned traffic? We currently log requests without Accept-Model, but not classified.

sam: Plan: server will accept no-header requests for 8 weeks but tag them as `unpinned` in metrics. After the window, requests without Accept-Model get 409 + a `X-Redwood-Suggested-Model` header. SDKs will add header automatically. Example header: 

```
Accept-Model: redwood-1.2.0
```

maria: For streaming endpoints — is there any response-shape risk? Some customers parse the stream envelope strictly.

liz: No structural stream changes planned. This is only a handshake header. We'll add a soft-warning field in response metadata for a rolling week before enforcement so integrators see the warning without breakage.

kevin: Who's owning customer comms + changelog? We need an enterprise email 2 weeks before enforcement and a public changelog entry.

sam: @release-bot can you create a draft changelog PR and an enterprise email template? Please tag @maria for review.

release-bot: Created PR https://git.internal/redwood/changelogs/pulls/1234 and added task RT-432 to the release board. :white_check_mark:

maria: I'll review the PR tomorrow. Quick ask: can Dedicated customers request an extended opt-out window? Some contracts will need >8 weeks.

sam: Yes — we'll include a Dedicated exemption toggle (ops-managed). Add a short runbook for enabling per-customer exemptions.

liz: Also adding a tiny migration snippet for SDK README: `client.setModel('redwood-1.2.0')`. We should include one-liner for curl too.

kevin: Suggested curl example: `curl -H "Accept-Model: redwood-1.2.0" ...` and mention server 409 response body contains `help_url` and `suggested_model`.

sam: Fine to start internal announcement Friday AM? I'll post the draft in #product then copy to #engineering and the partner mailing list.

maria: Fine by me. One more check: add a metric alert for % of unpinned traffic > 5% at the 6-week mark so we can push reminders.

sam: Good call. Ops will add that. Thanks all :thumbsup:
